## Project Overview

The Wellness Ranch On-Page SEO Strategy project demonstrates the application of search engine optimization, digital marketing research, and website performance analysis to a nonprofit organization.

Wellness Ranch Equine Assisted Therapy is a nonprofit organization based in Rancho Cucamonga, California, providing equine-assisted therapeutic services.

The project focused on developing a comprehensive SEO strategy to improve website discoverability, strengthen organic search visibility, and connect prospective clients with relevant therapeutic resources.

::: {.callout-note}
## Individual Contribution

I served as the On-Page SEO Team Lead, contributing to keyword research, website auditing, metadata optimization, internal linking, structured data planning, and strategic performance recommendations.
:::

## Business Problem

Nonprofit organizations frequently face challenges competing for online visibility due to limited marketing resources, technical website constraints, and competition from established service providers.

For Wellness Ranch, improving organic search visibility represents an opportunity to increase awareness of equine-assisted therapy and connect with individuals searching for mental health and therapeutic services.

The project addressed the following strategic challenges:

- Limited non-branded keyword visibility.
- Website crawlability and indexing concerns.
- Opportunities to improve metadata and content structure.
- Limited organic search measurement capabilities.
- Opportunities to strengthen internal linking.
- Website accessibility and technical performance.

## Keyword Research and Search Intent

Keyword research focused on identifying relevant search queries associated with equine-assisted therapy, mental health services, and local therapeutic resources.

Keywords were evaluated according to:

- Relevance to organizational services.
- Search volume.
- Keyword difficulty.
- Geographic relevance.
- Search intent.
- Potential contribution to website engagement.

### Search Intent Classification

| Search intent | User objective | Illustrative keyword |
|---|---|---|
| Informational | Learn about a therapeutic service. | What is equine-assisted therapy? |
| Navigational | Locate a specific organization. | Wellness Ranch Therapy |
| Commercial | Evaluate available therapeutic options. | Equine therapy near me |
| Transactional | Contact or request a service. | Schedule equine therapy consultation |
| Local | Identify nearby service providers. | Equine therapy Rancho Cucamonga |

The keyword examples illustrate the targeting strategy rather than verified keyword rankings.

### Keyword Mapping

Keyword mapping connects relevant search queries with appropriate website pages.

| Website page | Illustrative keyword focus |
|---|---|
| Homepage | Equine-assisted therapy |
| About page | Wellness Ranch equine therapy |
| Services page | Equine-assisted psychotherapy |
| FAQ page | Benefits of equine-assisted therapy |
| Contact page | Equine therapy Rancho Cucamonga |
| Blog content | How equine-assisted therapy works |

This approach helps establish topical relevance while reducing unnecessary competition between website pages.

## On-Page SEO Optimization

On-page SEO focuses on improving individual website pages to strengthen their relevance, accessibility, and search engine discoverability.

### Optimization Components

| Component | Strategic application |
|---|---|
| Title tags | Develop descriptive, keyword-aligned page titles. |
| Meta descriptions | Communicate page relevance and encourage search engagement. |
| H1 headings | Establish a clear primary topic for each page. |
| H2 and H3 headings | Organize supporting content logically. |
| Image alt text | Improve accessibility and communicate image context. |
| URL structure | Maintain descriptive and understandable page addresses. |
| Internal links | Connect related content and support website navigation. |
| Calls to action | Guide visitors toward relevant next steps. |

### Metadata Optimization Example

::: {.demo-card}

**Illustrative optimized title**

Equine-Assisted Therapy in Rancho Cucamonga | Wellness Ranch

**Illustrative meta description**

Discover equine-assisted therapy at Wellness Ranch in Rancho Cucamonga. Learn about therapeutic services and explore available resources.

:::

The example demonstrates how metadata can communicate service relevance, geographic context, and organizational identity.

## Technical SEO

Technical SEO focuses on improving the ability of search engines to discover, crawl, understand, and index website content.

The technical SEO evaluation addressed the following areas.

| Technical component | Evaluation focus |
|---|---|
| Crawlability | Identify barriers preventing search engines from accessing pages. |
| Indexability | Evaluate whether relevant pages can appear in search results. |
| XML sitemap | Support search engine discovery of important website pages. |
| Mobile usability | Improve the experience across mobile devices. |
| Core Web Vitals | Evaluate loading performance, responsiveness, and visual stability. |
| Broken links | Identify links leading to unavailable resources. |
| Image optimization | Reduce unnecessary image file sizes. |
| HTTPS | Support secure website communication. |

Technical recommendations were developed to support future implementation and monitoring.

## Internal Linking Strategy

Internal linking helps users navigate related content while supporting search engines in understanding website structure.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    A[Homepage] --> B[About Wellness Ranch]
    A --> C[Therapeutic Services]
    A --> D[Frequently Asked Questions]
    A --> E[Educational Resources]
    A --> F[Contact Page]
    B --> C
    C --> D
    C --> F
    D --> F
    E --> C
    E --> D
```

A structured internal linking strategy can support:

- Website navigation.
- Content discoverability.
- Relationships between relevant topics.
- Visitor engagement.
- Access to important service information.
- Conversion opportunities.

## Structured Data and Schema Markup

Structured data provides machine-readable information that helps search engines understand website entities and content.

The project considered several schema types.

| Schema type | Potential application |
|---|---|
| Organization | Communicate organizational identity. |
| LocalBusiness | Describe relevant local business information where appropriate. |
| FAQPage | Identify frequently asked questions and answers. |
| BreadcrumbList | Communicate website navigation hierarchy. |

### JSON-LD Example

The following example demonstrates a simplified organizational schema structure.

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Organization",
  "name": "Wellness Ranch Equine Assisted Therapy",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "addressLocality": "Rancho Cucamonga",
    "addressRegion": "CA",
    "addressCountry": "US"
  }
}
```

Structured data can improve machine-readable content interpretation. However, implementation does not guarantee higher rankings or enhanced search result appearances.

## Website Accessibility and User Experience

Website accessibility is an important component of an effective digital marketing strategy, particularly for organizations serving individuals seeking therapeutic support.

Accessibility considerations included:

- Descriptive image alternative text.
- Appropriate heading hierarchy.
- Readable typography.
- Sufficient color contrast.
- Descriptive link text.
- Mobile-friendly navigation.
- Clear calls to action.
- Accessible website content.

These considerations support a more inclusive and effective website experience.

## SEO Performance Measurement

A successful SEO strategy requires measurable objectives and ongoing performance evaluation.

### Proposed Key Performance Indicators

| KPI | Proposed target | Time frame |
|---|---|---|
| Organic website traffic | Increase by 20–30% | Six months |
| Target keyword rankings | Improve by 10–20% using an agreed ranking measure | 90 days |
| Educational content | Publish two optimized articles | Monthly |
| Local search visibility | Improve relevant local search presence | Ongoing |
| Website performance | Target Lighthouse performance score above 85 | Following optimization |
| Organic engagement | Improve engagement with relevant service pages | Ongoing |
| Organic conversions | Establish baseline and monitor improvement | Ongoing |

::: {.callout-important}
## Performance Measurement Disclaimer

These indicators represent proposed strategic targets rather than verified campaign outcomes. Actual performance should be evaluated using validated baseline measurements and post-implementation analytics.
:::

## Project Limitations

The project primarily focused on research, website evaluation, strategic planning, and optimization recommendations.

Several limitations should be considered:

- Proposed SEO targets are not verified performance outcomes.
- Search engine rankings and keyword metrics change over time.
- Some recommendations depend on website administration access.
- Search Console and analytics measurement require appropriate configuration.
- Organic search performance depends on multiple external factors.
- Implementation effectiveness requires ongoing monitoring.

No unsupported claims regarding traffic growth, ranking improvements, or conversion increases are presented.
